sculpt_stool.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_stool.notes: Sculpted three-legged stool: oval bevelled seat with a worn hollow, three splayed round legs with wedged through-tenons, the front leg mended with a splint and cord. Footprint is a tripod (about 0.62 x 0.56 m) inside the old 0.675 square. Vertex colours on every LOD, material `wood` as prop_stool.
